front.title: Secure Shell (SSH) Post-Quantum/Traditional Hybrid Key Exchange Methods Using Scloud+

abstract.t: This document defines four Post-Quantum/Traditional (PQ/T) hybrid key exchange methods for the Secure Shell (SSH) protocol. They combine the Scloud+ key-encapsulation mechanism, whose security relies on the unstructured Learning With Errors (LWE) problem, with Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman over the NIST P-384 and P-521 curves.
